name: Noro RiskTurtle: 40-bar breakout entry, 20-bar channel midline stop, 2% risk sizing
author: Noro
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: Buy-stop at highest high of 40 bars (+1 tick optional) when flat.
entry_short: Sell-stop at lowest low of 40 bars (-1 tick optional) when flat.
exit: Exit via stop at the midpoint of the 20-bar Donchian channel ((highest high 20 + lowest low 20)/2).
stop_loss: 20-bar channel midpoint (stop-loss and exit are the same level)
position_sizing: Position size = equity / close x (risk% / |center/entry-1|*100); default risk 2% long and short.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Variant of Turtle breakout with midline stop and fixed-risk sizing; distinct from existing Noro SimpleTurtle/Turtles entries.
